theme: भक्ति और ज्ञान: शास्त्र का अति-गोपनीय योग / Devotion and wisdom: the ancient secret of yoga
context: Arjuna is still processing Krishna's claim that the teaching is timeless and passed down through the line of sages. Krishna answers by making a deeply personal point: this wisdom is being given now because Arjuna is a devoted friend, not because of any ordinary social status. The verse is about transmission and trust, not a boast about chronology or power.
contextHindi: अर्जुन अभी भी यह समझ नहीं पा रहे हैं कि कृष्ण का यह शास्त्र कितने समय से चला आ रहा है, फिर वह आज उन्हें क्यों बता रहे हैं। कृष्ण का जवाब व्यक्तिगत है: यह ज्ञान आज इसलिए दिया जा रहा है, क्योंकि अर्जुन उनका भक्त और मित्र है। यह श्लोक अहंकार का नहीं, भक्ति और शुद्ध ग्रहण की तैयारी का संकेत है।
sanskritDevanagari:
स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः |
भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम् ||४-३||
transliteration:
sa evāyaṃ mayā te.adya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ .
bhakto.asi me sakhā ceti rahasyaṃ hyetaduttamam ||4-3||
spokenHindi: कृष्ण कहते हैं कि वही प्राचीन योग आज उन्होंने अर्जुन को बताया है। वे अर्जुन को अपना भक्त और मित्र कहते हैं। फिर वे इस शिक्षा को उत्तम रहस्य बताते हैं। श्लोक में इतना ही कहा गया है। इसमें यह नहीं बताया गया कि ‘रहस्य’ का अर्थ कोई ऐसी बात है जिसे छिपाकर रखना चाहिए, या इसे समझने के लिए कोई खास शर्त है। पिछले श्लोक में कृष्ण ने कहा था कि यह योग परंपरा से चला और समय के साथ लुप्त हो गया। इस संदर्भ में ‘वही’ उस पुराने योग की ओर लौटता है। स्वामी शिवानंद की टिप्पणी इस योग की शिक्षाओं को गहरा और सूक्ष्म कहती है। इसे टिप्पणी के रूप में समझें, श्लोक के शब्दशः अर्थ के रूप में नहीं। यहाँ भक्ति और मित्रता अर्जुन के बारे में कृष्ण के अपने शब्द हैं।
clearEnglish: Krishna says that He has taught Arjuna this same ancient yoga today. He calls Arjuna His devotee and friend, and describes the teaching as the highest secret. Those are the claims made in the verse. It does not define “secret” as something to be concealed, nor does it explain a special condition required for understanding it. In the preceding verse, Krishna says that this yoga was handed down through a succession and was lost over time; “the same” in this verse points back to that teaching. Swami Sivananda’s commentary explains that the ancient yoga consists of profound and subtle teachings, which is why it is called the supreme secret. That explanation is commentary, rather than an additional literal phrase in the verse. The verse itself connects Krishna’s teaching to Arjuna’s devotion and friendship.

interpretationPerspectives.label: TEXT
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The verse says that this ancient yoga is taught to Arjuna because he is Krishna’s devotee and friend. It calls the teaching a supreme secret.

interpretationPerspectives.label: COMMENTARY (DLS)
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The DLS commentary says this ancient Yoga consists of profound and subtle teachings; hence it is the supreme secret revealed by the Lord to Arjuna.

interpretationPerspectives.label: INFERENCE
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: We can reasonably infer that spiritual teaching is not only about content but about the inner condition of the listener. Devotion, humility, and a sincere willingness to learn are not emotional extras; they shape whether knowledge becomes transformative.

practicalApplication.label: Approach the teacher with humility
practicalApplication.text: When you study or listen, ask not only what is being said but what in you is resisting it. A short daily pause before study—'What am I ready to learn, and what do I still want to control?'—can make a big difference.

practicalApplication.label: Make study personal
practicalApplication.text: Instead of collecting verses as information, write one sentence each day about what you need to soften in yourself: ego, fear, impatience, or attachment to being right. This makes wisdom less theoretical and more lived.

reflectionQuestion: What in me is ready to hear wisdom, and what in me still wants to keep the teacher at a distance?
reflectionQuestionHindi: मेरे भीतर कौन-सा हिस्सा ज्ञान सुनने के लिए तैयार है, और कौन-सा हिस्सा अभी भी गुरु या सच्चाई को दूरी पर रखता है?
